passages.text: In a cave behind the biggest hill in Raleigh lived a dragon named Cinder. Cinder had a terrible problem. Every time he tried to roar, out came... a squeak.
Cinder decided to march to the top of the hill like a soldier and practice. “HUT, HUT!” he stomped, left-right-left-right. But his roar still came out “eep!”
Then a brave knight named Pepper rode up on her bicycle. “Maybe your roar is just shy,” she said. “Have you tried gargling with lemonade?”
Cinder gargled the lemonade, took the BIGGEST breath ever, and let out the mightiest ROARRRR! It was so loud the stars giggled. And Cinder never squeaked again. The end!

title: The Dragon Who Lost His Roar
